checks: Repeated standalone debug/release, strict Clippy, compiled mutant, paired syntax.
cost: Bounded exhaustive fixtures: flow 729 DAG capacity arrays times 4 limits, 64 cyclic graphs times 4 limits; MCS and core 1024 topologies (core 7 thresholds and 32 subsets); dominators 4096 graphs times 4 starts with deletion reachability; reduction 4096 graphs with edge-removal reachability. These are per-file domains, not all tests in every file. No benchmark or speed claim.
forward: Generate fixed exhaustive small domains for k_core; independent oracle predicts output, assert production correspondence plus validation/boundary behavior. All assertions passing returns Pass. Any mismatched fixture causes named failure; bounded success is not universal proof.
inverse: For a fixed fixture collection, Pass is excluded if any production observation differs from the independent oracle or validation assertion; a named Failure is excluded when its compared values agree. This relation excludes false-green and false-red harness observations; tests do not approximate unexecuted inputs.

Pass admits every implementation agreeing on all finite fixtures, including implementations that disagree elsewhere. Failure at fixture f admits implementations with its reported mismatch; it does not recover a unique bug. Distinct programs with identical observed fixture results lie in the same preimage.
limitations: Finite checks only; allocation failure untyped; partial syntax; no approximate executable profiles.
state: Finite generated test fixtures and observation Pass or a named assertion failure; ordinary Rust execution.
